title: Intraoperative STN/thalamic DBS-lead LFP with subgaleal sensorimotor strips during a stop-signal task (Diesburg, Greenlee & Wessel, 2021)
description: Intraoperative local field potential recordings from deep brain stimulation leads in the subthalamic nucleus or ventral intermediate thalamus, acquired together with subgaleal electrode strips over sensorimotor cortex. Patients undergoing DBS surgery performed an auditory stop-signal task and a go-only localizer task. The dataset comprises 47 recordings from 23 subjects and supports analysis of cortico-subcortical beta burst dynamics during movement cancellation.
methods_description: Recordings were made during DBS surgery at the University of Iowa Hospitals and Clinics (April 2018 to March 2020) using a TDT system with an RA16PA Medusa preamplifier and RA16LI headstage, with a 7.5 kHz hardware low-pass filter. Medtronic 3387 DBS leads were placed in the STN or VIM, and 4-, 6- or 8-contact subgaleal strips were placed over sensorimotor cortex. Sampling rates were 2000 or 24000 Hz. Task triggers were recorded as TTL pulses on analog input channels.
